Erling Haaland.story: Haaland followed his Salzburg and Dortmund breakthroughs with Manchester City's 2022/23 treble. His penalty-area movement made him an immediate Premier League scoring benchmark; City's 2025/26 FA Cup and League Cup double added another chapter to that record.
Erling Haaland.recent: 2026: FA Cup and League Cup winner with Manchester City.

Kylian Mbappé.story: Mbappé won the 2018 World Cup as a teenager, scored a hat-trick in the 2022 final and joined Real Madrid in 2024. His 2026 World Cup Golden Boot followed another prolific season in Spain.
Kylian Mbappé.recent: 2026: World Cup Golden Boot; 2025/26 Champions League top scorer.

Bukayo Saka.story: From Hale End to Arsenal's number seven, Saka became a defining player in the club's return to the top. The 2025/26 Premier League title added a league championship to his 2020 FA Cup and helped cement his place in Arsenal supporters' hearts.

Bukayo Saka.recent: 2026: Premier League and Community Shield winner with Arsenal; World Cup bronze with England.

Jude Bellingham.story: Bellingham progressed from Birmingham City's first team at sixteen to Dortmund and then Real Madrid. He won La Liga and the Champions League in his first Madrid season, before helping England finish third at the 2026 World Cup.
Jude Bellingham.recent: 2026: World Cup bronze with England and Bronze Boot.

Vinícius Júnior.story: Vinícius scored in Real Madrid's 2022 and 2024 Champions League final victories. The Flamengo graduate became a leading attacker for club and country, winning The Best FIFA Men's Player award for 2024 while speaking out against racism in football.

Lamine Yamal.story: Yamal rose through Barcelona's academy to become a decisive senior international while still a teenager. Spain's Euro 2024 triumph was followed by the 2026 World Cup, alongside Barcelona's 2025/26 league title.
Lamine Yamal.recent: 2026: World Cup winner with Spain and La Liga winner with Barcelona.

Jamal Musiala.story: Musiala developed into Bayern Munich's elusive creator between the lines. A Champions League winner in 2020, he added the 2025/26 Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal double to a career already marked by influential performances for Germany.
Jamal Musiala.recent: 2026: Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal double with Bayern.

Florian Wirtz.story: Wirtz helped Bayer Leverkusen win an unbeaten Bundesliga title and the German Cup in 2023/24. He joined Liverpool in 2025, bringing his ability to find space and release runners to a new league.

Cole Palmer.recent: 2025: Conference League and Club World Cup winner; Club World Cup Golden Ball.

Pedri.story: Pedri moved from Las Palmas to Barcelona and became a key link between midfield control and attack. A Euro 2024 and 2026 World Cup winner with Spain, he also helped Barcelona retain La Liga in 2025/26.
Pedri.recent: 2026: World Cup winner with Spain and La Liga winner with Barcelona.

Rodri.story: Rodri scored Manchester City's winning goal in the 2023 Champions League final and won the 2024 Ballon d'Or. He claimed the Golden Ball during Spain's 2026 World Cup triumph before joining Barcelona that August.

Mohamed Salah.story: Salah's Liverpool career brought the 2019 Champions League, two Premier League titles and a succession of scoring awards. The Egyptian forward began a new chapter at Trabzonspor in August 2026 after becoming one of Liverpool's defining modern players.

Harry Kane.story: Kane became Tottenham and England's record scorer before moving to Bayern Munich in 2023. His first Bundesliga title in 2024/25 was followed by a German league-and-cup double and the European Golden Shoe in 2025/26.

Kevin De Bruyne.story: De Bruyne became the creative engine of Manchester City's six-title Premier League era and 2023 Champions League triumph. He moved to Napoli in 2025 after a decade in Manchester, continuing his career in Italian football.
